Notice

A non-interactive informational block — disclaimers, notes, tips, callouts. Two shells for two contexts, five intents shared by both. Only the icon (and, on Bordered, the left bar) carries the intent colour — text always stays neutral.

2 variants5 intentsToken-driven

Variants

Pick by context. Both share the same five intents and icon colours — only the shell and text placement differ.
Filled callout card
A tinted, rounded card. Icon + bold title sit on their own line, with the paragraph below — reads as a distinct block, good for standalone disclaimers and dedicated notes sections.

Bordered inline callout
No fill — just a coloured left bar. Icon + bold label lead straight into the paragraph on the same line, so it reads as part of the surrounding copy rather than a separate card.

Dark mode

Inside a .dark ancestor each intent takes Badge's dark fill and its */300 accent — the --color-notice-* tokens swap on their own, nothing per notice. Body text on the fills is 5.75:1 at the lowest (success). Figma: the Dark Purple mode of color/ui.

Anatomy

The parts of each variant and the token each is bound to. In both, only the icon (and the bordered variant's left bar) is intent-coloured — the title and paragraph always use the neutral text tokens.
Filled
Please note

Helper disclaimer text.

background → --color-notice-info-fill radius → --rounded-lg icon → --color-notice-info-accent title → --color-text-heading, 700 body → --color-text-body, 400 · 16/28
Bordered

Please note: Helper disclaimer text.

left bar → --color-notice-info-accent, 4px icon → --color-notice-info-accent label → --color-text-body, 700 (neutral) body → --color-text-body, 400

Props

Read from interface Props in Notice.astro, so it cannot drift from the component.
PropTypeDefaultNotes
variant'filled' | 'bordered''filled'filled is a tinted card with the title on its own line; bordered is a left bar with the title leading into the text.
intent'info' | 'success' | 'important' | 'warning' | 'danger''info'The icon and bar colour, by meaning — the text itself always stays neutral.
titlestring—RequiredThe bold heading, or the lead-in on bordered.
textstring—RequiredThe body paragraph.
livebooleantrueWhether the notice announces itself to a screen reader.
classstring—Extra classes on the <aside>, after the component's own.

Code

<!-- filled — icon is an inline SVG exported from Figma (circle-info, Font Awesome 7 Pro Regular) -->
<div class="notice notice--filled notice--info">
  <div class="notice-header">
    <svg class="notice-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path d="M10 3.5C6.4…"/></svg>
    <span class="notice-title">Please note</span>
  </div>
  <p class="notice-text">Aspose, SyncFusion, and iText are registered trademarks…</p>
</div>

<!-- bordered -->
<div class="notice notice--bordered notice--info">
  <p class="notice-text">
    <svg class="notice-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path d="M10 3.5C6.4…"/></svg>
    <b>Please note:</b> Aspose, SyncFusion, and iText are registered trademarks…
  </p>
</div>
.notice { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--spacing-xs); padding: var(--spacing-xl); max-width: 645px; }
.notice-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--spacing-xs); }
.notice-header .notice-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; }   /* the 20-box Figma draws, ink 16 */
.notice-title { font-size: var(--font-size-title-lg); line-height: var(--leading-7); font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text-heading); }
.notice-text { font-size: var(--font-size-body); line-height: var(--leading-7); color: var(--color-text-body); }
.notice-text .notice-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; vertical-align: top; position: relative; top: 4px; overflow: visible; }   /* viewBox="2 2 16 16": the ink, at 20 */

/* filled — only the icon carries the intent colour */
.notice--filled { border-radius: var(--rounded-lg); }
.notice--info { --notice-fill: var(--color-notice-info-fill); --notice-accent: var(--color-notice-info-accent); }
.notice--filled { background: var(--notice-fill); }
.notice-icon { color: var(--notice-accent); }   /* tokens swap under .dark */

/* bordered — coloured left bar, neutral body text */
.notice--bordered { border-left: var(--border-width-4) solid; padding: var(--spacing-xs) var(--spacing-xl) var(--spacing-xs) calc(var(--spacing-xl) - var(--border-width-4)); }
.notice--bordered { border-left-color: var(--notice-accent); }

Guidelines

✓ Do
Tips
  • Match the intent colour to the meaning (info ≠ warning ≠ danger).
  • Use Bordered inline within long-form content, Filled as a standalone callout.
  • Keep the title/label neutral — only the icon (and bar) should carry colour.
  • Icons are Font Awesome 7 Pro Regular glyphs exported from Figma as SVG paths, inlined with fill="currentColor" — no icon font or CDN dependency.
✗ Don't
Click here for details →
  • Don't make a Notice clickable — that's a Button or a real link.
  • Don't colour the title/paragraph text — that breaks the icon-only colour convention.
  • Don't use danger/warning for neutral information.
